blob: bidirectionally coupled fe-cfd simulation study on mql machining process of ti-6al-4v alloy in the context of sustainable manufacturing practices, minimum quantity lubrication (mql) has been extensively employed in machining operations involving hard-to-cut materials. while substantial experimental and numerical investigations on mql-assisted machining have been conducted, existing simulation approaches remain inadequate for modeling the dynamic flow field variations inherent to mql processes, significantly compromising the predictive reliability of current models. this study introduce 该论文研究ti-6al-4v合金的mql加工工艺模拟，未涉及任何后处理对力学性能的影响，与用户关注的后处理对疲劳/力学性能改进方向无关。 does not study the effect of post-processing on fatigue or mechanical performance; only simulates cutting temperature and force during mql machining of ti-6al-4v, with no connection to am post-processing or mechanical property improvement. 现有mql加工模拟方法无法准确反映动态流场变化，预测可靠性低。 提出双向迭代耦合fe-cfd模型，交替传递热通量和对流换热系数直至收敛。 模拟的切削温度和主切削力与实验值吻合良好，验证了耦合方法的预测能力。 通过车削实验对比温度与力数据验证模拟精度。 mql machining ti-6al-4v fe-cfd simulation minimum quantity lubrication 微量润滑 bidirectional coupling 双向耦合 finite element analysis 有限元分析 computational fluid dynamics 计算流体动力学 cutting temperature 切削温度 principal force 主切削力 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 xiaorong zhou, lin he, sen yuan, hongwan jiang, jing deng lubricants school of mechanical engineering, guiyang university, guiyang 550005, china

blob: microstructural evolution and performance of heat-treated ti6al4v in laser powder bed fusion ti6al4v parts produced via laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) frequently exhibit high residual stress, where heat treatment has been utilized to relieve this stress. this study aims to investigate the effect of annealing heat treatment on the overall performance of ti6al4v fabricated using lpbf. printed ti6al4v samples were heat treated at 935 °c for 8 hours with a heating rate of 5 °c/min and a cooling rate of 0.60 °c/min. the overall performance such as physical properties, mechanical properties a 论文直接研究了ti6al4v激光粉末床熔融后的热处理（退火）对微观结构和力学性能（拉伸、硬度、密度）的影响，符合l2后处理控制方向。 the paper does not include fatigue testing, which is a key mechanical performance aspect mentioned in the direction focus. 研究退火热处理对lpbf ti6al4v性能的影响，以释放残余应力。 在935°c退火8小时，比较打印态与热处理态的物理、力学和微观结构。 退火使密度达99.28%，延展性提高231%，但抗拉强度下降28%，硬度下降13%，微观结构从α'马氏体转变为α+β。 通过密度、表面粗糙度、拉伸、硬度测试和显微观察验证。 ti-6al-4v laser powder bed fusion heat treatment annealing mechanical properties microstructure laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 heat treatment 热处理 annealing 退火 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 mechanical properties 力学性能 microstructure 微观结构 density 密度 tensile strength 抗拉强度 ductility 延展性 hardness 硬度 farhana mohd foudzi, minhalina ahmad buhairi, fathin iliana jamhari, norhamidi muhamad, intan fadhlina mohamed sains malaysiana

blob: influence of tool clearance angle and cutting conditions on tool life when turning ti-6al-4v—design of experiments approach the titanium alloy ti-6al-4v is widely used in the aerospace, medical, and automotive industries; however, its machining remains challenging due to its low thermal conductivity and high chemical reactivity. this study investigates the influence of the tool clearance angle on tool wear during the turning of ti-6al-4v under wet cutting conditions. a design of experiments (doe) approach was employed, varying the clearance angle, cutting speed, and feed rate to determine their effects on tool wear.  该论文研究的是ti-6al-4v的机械加工（车削）过程中的刀具寿命，与增材制造后处理无关。 the paper does not address post-processing of additively manufactured ti-6al-4v; it focuses on tool wear during conventional turning, not on improving fatigue/mechanical performance via post-processing. ti-6al-4v加工困难，研究刀具后角对刀具寿命的影响。 采用实验设计方法，改变后角、切削速度和进给率，分析刀具磨损。 后角对月牙洼磨损和刀具寿命有显著影响，优化后角可减少刀具磨损。 通过3d形貌测量和回归分析验证模型准确性。 ti-6al-4v machining tool wear design of experiments clearance angle ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v tool clearance angle 刀具后角 tool wear 刀具磨损 design of experiments 实验设计 turning 车削 3d topography 三维形貌 regression analysis 回归分析 adam lukáš, miroslav gombár, j sýkora, josef sklenička, jaroslava fulemová journal of manufacturing and materials processing department of machining technology, faculty of mechanical engineering, university of west bohemia in pilsen, 30100 pilsen, czech republic
